spells/major-creation-2406.name: Major Creation
spells/major-creation-2406.effectSummary: Functions as minor creation, creating one unattended nonmagical object up to 1 cubic foot per caster level and requiring an appropriate Craft check for complex objects; using a created object as a material component causes the spell to fail. Major creation additionally allows mineral objects such as stone, crystal, or metal. Duration depends on material: vegetable matter lasts 2 hours/level; stone, crystal, and base metals 1 hour/level; precious metals 20 minutes/level; gems 10 minutes/level; and rare metals 1 round/level. Rare metals include adamantine, alchemical silver, and mithral. Cold iron cannot be created.
spells/major-creation-2406.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Minor Creation supplies the shared object-volume, Craft-check, and material-component restrictions. The primary catalog omits the visible duration table from parsed effect text, so the table was independently verified against the Revised 3.5 SRD / same-printing references before locking.

spells/holy-star-2213.name: Holy Star
spells/holy-star-2213.effectSummary: Creates a candle-bright mote for 1 round/level with one of three functions chosen as a free action on your turn. Spell Turning mode turns a total of 1d4+3 spell levels using spell turning's normal rules: only targeted spells and spell-like effects are turned, not area/effect spells or touch-range spells; a higher-level incoming spell can be partially turned proportionally; if both sides have spell turning active, use the normal resonating-field d% outcomes. Turning capacity spent by Holy Star stays spent for the spell's duration, and this mode stops working when all capacity is used. Protection mode grants a +10 circumstance bonus to AC. Fire Bolt mode makes a ranged touch attack against a creature within 90 feet for 1d6 fire damage per two caster levels, maximum 10d6.
spells/holy-star-2213.notes: Player's Guide to Faerûn printing, digest-locked. The source explicitly sets Holy Star's smaller 1d4+3 turning capacity while importing Spell Turning's targeting, partial-turning, and resonating-field mechanics. The source-specific AC and fire-bolt functions are preserved directly.
